rules.requirement: Initial treatment plan must be signed by staff and client at admission/intake date.
Master treatment plan must be completed within 30 days of admission and signed by client and therapist/staff.
Ongoing updates should be tracked from Treatment Plan Reviews, not the Treatment Plan version history.
PHP uses a 30-day cadence and IOP-5 uses a 60-day cadence; active LOC is inferred from no discharge date.
Treatment plan review completion should track therapist/staff signature date; client signature is not always required.
Compare document-provided next due date with calculated cadence due date and surface mismatches.
Replace manual Asana date tracking for nearly 60 clients with an in-app reliable due-date queue.

open_questions: Is the IOP-5 due date anchored to LOC effective date, review signature date, created date, or the document Next Review Due field?
Are recurrence intervals calendar days or business days?
Should document-provided Next Review Due be authoritative or only a cross-check?
What exact LOC-change update window should be configured?
